title: Multiwave headroom & safety stock calculator - private deployments
summary: Working spreadsheet to estimate GPU counts and BOM for multi-region Private/VPC deployments. Includes steady-state baseline sizing, surge headroom by wave, safety stock for hardware failures + maintenance, and a simple BOM price estimate (GPU cards, nodes, racks). This is an iterative planning tool for infra/product to agree on purchase tranches and lead-time buffers.
assumptions: 1) Model: mix of MPT-30B and Llama2-70B equivalents; throughput per GPU derived from 8-bit quantized perf tests. 2) Average sequence length (tokens/request) and tokenization rates per workload provided by product. 3) On-prem nodes hold 8 GPUs each. 4) Rack density assumed 40U with 10 nodes/rack average (varies by SKU). 5) Safety stock is multiplicative after raw GPU need: SafetyStockGPUs = ceil(RawGPUs * safety_percent). 6) Surge waves are additive headroom over baseline and reserved capacity is left untouched for SLA tiering.
body:
Sheet: 
Columns: Region, BaselineQPS, P95_latency_ms_target, Model_mix, Avg_seq_tokens, tokens_per_request, tokens_per_gpu_sec, Raw_GPU_need, Safety_percent, Safety_stock_gpu, Surge_wave1_headroom, Surge_wave2_headroom, Total_gpus_provisioned, Nodes_needed(8gpu), Estimated_GPU_cost_USD, Estimated_node_cost_USD, Notes

Rows:
us-west-2, 1200, 150, 60% MPT-30B / 40% L2-70B, 256, 3200, 12000, =ceil((BaselineQPS * tokens_per_request) / tokens_per_gpu_sec), 0.25, =ceil(Raw_GPU_need * 0.25), 50, 30, =Raw_GPU_need + Safety_stock_gpu + 50 + 30, =ceil(Total_gpus_provisioned / 8), 4,000,000, 720,000, Primary US cluster; prefer purchase tranche A (Q2)

eu-west-1, 400, 180, 80% MPT-30B / 20% L2-70B, 220, 2800, 11000, =ceil((BaselineQPS * tokens_per_request) / tokens_per_gpu_sec), 0.30, =ceil(Raw_GPU_need * 0.30), 20, 10, =Raw_GPU_need + Safety_stock_gpu + 20 + 10, =ceil(Total_gpus_provisioned / 8), 1,200,000, 240,000, Secondary region; constrained power racks

ap-southeast-1, 250, 200, 100% MPT-30B, 300, 3600, 10000, =ceil((BaselineQPS * tokens_per_request) / tokens_per_gpu_sec), 0.35, =ceil(Raw_GPU_need * 0.35), 10, 5, =Raw_GPU_need + Safety_stock_gpu + 10 + 5, =ceil(Total_gpus_provisioned / 8), 800,000, 160,000, Spot-capable pool planned (10% of capacity)

Notes on formulas: tokens_per_request = Avg_seq_tokens * (1 + prompt_overhead). We use prompt_overhead=0.25 by default. tokens_per_gpu_sec is benchmarked per model family and quantization profile (values above are synthesis of internal perf runs). Raw GPU need is computed per region for steady-state QPS and then converted to node/rack counts. Surge waves are discrete headroom buckets used for marketing promos and batch inference bursts.

Quick sensitivities:
- Increasing safety_percent from 25% -> 35% increases total GPUs by ~10-12% across regions due to ceil() at node boundaries.
- Moving 20% of workload to a cheaper quantized variant reduces tokens_per_request estimate by ~8% and can reduce GPUs needed by ~7% for the same latency SLO.

This sheet intentionally mixes calculated columns (formula text used for clarity) and hand-tuned headroom numbers to reflect operational decisions (e.g., leave extra capacity for canary rolls, scheduled maintenance).
calculation_example: Example (us-west-2): BaselineQPS=1200, Avg_seq_tokens=256, prompt_overhead=0.25 -> tokens_per_request=256*1.25=320. tokens/sec needed = 1200 * 320 = 384,000 tokens/sec. tokens_per_gpu_sec (mixed model weighted avg) = 12,000. Raw GPUs = ceil(384,000 / 12,000) = 32. Safety_percent=25% -> Safety_stock = ceil(32 * 0.25) = 8. Surge wave1=50, wave2=30. Total_gpus = 32 + 8 + 50 + 30 = 120. Nodes (8 GPU/node) = ceil(120/8) = 15 nodes. Estimated GPU cost (unit avg) approx $33,333 (enterprise card) => GPU subtotal ~= 120 * 33,333 = 4,000,000 USD. Node chassis + network + DC costs ~= 15 * 48,000 = 720,000 USD.
bom_breakdown:
BOM (baseline tranche A):
- GPU: Acer/PNY style enterprise 80GB class (SKU-ENT-80), unit_price_est = 33,333 USD, lead_time = 12-20 weeks, warranty 3y
- Node chassis: 8x GPU node (SKU-8G-CHAS), unit_price_est = 48,000 USD, includes NVMe, network cards, power distribution
- Rack & PDUs: 42U rack + PDUs = 6,000 USD per rack
- Networking: Spine/leaf incremental per region = 120,000 USD (one-time for new colo)
- Installation/ops & kitting = 8% of HW cost (labor + shipping)

Cost example (us-west-2 tranche A): GPUs 120 * 33,333 = 4,000,000; Nodes 15 * 48,000 = 720,000; Racks 2 * 6,000 = 12,000; Networking 120,000; Ops 8% -> ~353,000; SUBTOTAL = ~5,205,000 USD.

Finance to review tranche A CAPEX and propose amortization schedule
